bio.text: Tom Kean, Jr. represents New Jersey's 7th Congressional District and is serving his second term; he sits on the Energy and Commerce and Foreign Affairs committees.
He was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly in 2001, then moved to the New Jersey Senate, where he served 14 years as Republican Leader.
Earlier he worked at the Environmental Protection Agency and as a legislative staffer for Rep. Bob Franks.
He graduated from Dartmouth College and received a master's degree in law and diplomacy from the Fletcher School at Tufts University.
